item.title: If A Guy Displays These 62 Behaviors, You Might Be Dealing With A Man-Child
item.description: There are certain behaviors that just scream “this person needs to grow up” but it’s often only clearly visible when it’s too late. So we’ve gathered some of the best examples from a thread where people share behaviors they think are solid proof someone is a “man-child.”

item.title: 64 Cool Maps To Enjoy Even If You’re Not A Cartography Enthusiast
item.description: Do you know how many blue whales would fit into the city of the Vatican? Have you any idea how the ancient continent of Pangea would look like if countries had their modern political borders? And did you ever see what Manhattan looked like when it was still called New Amsterdam? If not, this list of fascinating maps is exactly for you. If you're a visual learner, scroll through these maps and see the world in maps like you've never seen it before.

item.title: Over 300K People Follow This X Page To Go Down The Memory Lane Back To The ‘80s
item.description: Given what’s been happening around the world these past few years, you’d be forgiven for daydreaming about the past. Recent decades seem like a much simpler, calmer, clearer time. And many folks feel nostalgia specifically for the 1980s. Today, we’re featuring some of the most nostalgic images, as shared by the iconic ‘OldSchool80s’ social media project. Put on your rose-colored glasses and get ready to take a trip into the past.

item.title: Women Go Undercover In Incel Forums And It’s Way Worse Than Anyone Can Imagine
item.description: “Incel” is short for “involuntary celibate,” often used for men who say they want a relationship but feel unable to find one. Many end up blaming women and directing their frustration at them. While social media platforms have banned some incel groups over violent content, dedicated forums still exist where they post freely. In a TikTok video, one woman shared a look inside one of them, and what she found was shocking and hard to unsee.

item.title: Woman Tells Family That No Kids Are Allowed In Her Home, Brother Feels Targeted
item.description: "No kids at family gatherings" was the new rule at this woman's house. Her brother, who was the only sibling with kids, really took it to heart. "This rule is clearly aimed at me," he complained. When he shared his story online, it sparked an interesting debate: some people believed it's okay to leave kids at home to attend family gatherings. Others, however, thought kids should be included.

item.title: People Admit They Silently Judge Others If They Do These 97 Things
item.description: There are all kinds of people who can get under our skin: slow walkers, folks who refuse to wear headphones on public transport, even passengers who clap when the plane lands. But as frustrated as we get, we don’t always show it. Most of the time we bite our tongue and keep the judgment to ourselves—at least in person. On TikTok, one woman asked people to confess the things they silently judge others for but would never admit out loud, and the replies were brutally honest.

item.description: Good owners are bound to do anything and everything to protect their beloved pets. But the visit might cost you a pretty penny.
